name: lean-trees
cmd: export LEAN_PATH=$PWD:$(dirname $(dirname $(readlink -f $(elan which lean))))/lib/lean; lean -o Cert.olean Cert.lean && lean -o Kernel.olean Kernel.lean && lean -o Progress.olean Progress.lean && lean -o StepLaw.olean StepLaw.lean && lean -o Steps.olean Steps.lean && lean Trees.lean 2>&1 | tail -3; s=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; echo lean-exit $s; exit $s

name: check
cmd: bun install >/dev/null 2>&1; echo TSC; bunx tsc -p . 2>&1 | grep "error TS"; t=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; echo LINT; bunx oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --disable-nested-config 2>&1 | grep -E "^  [x!] |,-\[|Found"; l=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; echo "tsc=$t lint=$l"; [ $t = 0 ] && [ $l = 0 ]

name: lean-conformance
cmd: export LEAN_PATH=$PWD:$(dirname $(dirname $(readlink -f $(elan which lean))))/lib/lean; lean -o Cert.olean Cert.lean && lean -o Kernel.olean Kernel.lean && bun conformance.ts 600 > Conformance.lean && lean Conformance.lean 2>&1 | tail -20; s=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; grep -c '^example' Conformance.lean; echo lean-exit $s; exit $s
